verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is described throughout as a terminal-based agentic coding tool that edits files, runs toolchains, and presents diffs for approval — not an inline-completion engine. The only IDE-related evidence (byteask-docs-28) just says 'connectors are live' for VS Code/Cursor/JetBrains without any mention of inline completions or next-edit suggestions as-you-type.
